annotations.title: Booking.com data: hotels and guest reviews

description: One node for Booking.com: 10 hotels or apartments in a city with prices for your dates, or the 20 newest guest reviews of a property. Each action has a price. Use it when: A travel task needs places to stay in a city with prices and ratings, or what guests say about a specific property. Not for: Making a reservation; it returns links, it does not book. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 58 s. Actions: hotels (10 places to stay in a city, with prices for your dates; needs city); reviews (20 newest guest reviews of a property; needs url). Price: from $0.053 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on action: reviews $0.053, hotels $0.054 (default hotels). One call = one Booking.com action (hotels or reviews).

action.description: What to do; sets the price. hotels (needs city), reviews (needs url). Default hotels

adults.description: Optional number of adults, default 2 (for: hotels)

city.description: City or area, e.g. Lisbon (for: hotels)

url.description: The property's Booking.com URL, e.g. from Hotel search (for: reviews)
